system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Non-Western defense industry ascendancy narrative",
    "detail": "Framing non-Western countries' defense industry growth as rising amid conflict, suggesting conflict-driven success.",
    "debias": "Report defense industry developments with economic context rather than conflict-enablement framing.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Turkiye has rapidly expanded its defence industry to become a leading global missile exporter amid rising conflict.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/4/16/turkiyes-roketsan-eyes-top-10-exporter-rank-amid-middle-east-conflict?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "Turkiye has expanded its defence industry to become a leading global missile exporter."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Athlete-official sport diplomacy equivalence",
    "detail": "Presenting sports interactions between officials as noteworthy diplomatic moments on par with formal negotiations.",
    "debias": "Report sports activities by officials as ceremonial events separate from policy discussions.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Hockey took centre stage in Ottawa on Tuesday as Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Finnish President Alexander Stubb joined local players on the ice, combining sport with diplomacy during Stubb's first official visit to Canada.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/video/2026/04/16/canadas-mark-carney-finlands-alexander-stubb-play-hockey",
    "unbiased_text": "Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Finnish President Alexander Stubb played hockey with local players in Ottawa during Stubb's official visit to Canada."
  }
]
